free_tier.stated: no free tier: compute bills per second from $0.07 an hour for 1 vCPU and 2 GiB, and a paused sandbox costs nothing; volumes and egress are free

per_object_cap.notes: a sandbox has a disk ceiling rather than an object cap; the card does not carry it

retention.notes: Disk durability across instance stops and deletions is not documented.

interface_detail: Access interface not documented in published terms.

limits.value: $0.07 an hour for Micro at 1 vCPU and 2 GiB, up to $1.12 for XL at 16 vCPU and 32 GiB
a paused sandbox costs nothing; egress and volumes are not metered
the page states no disk cap per sandbox; it says hosting public images and Kits is free

limits_note: Session cap, idle-reap and network policy are not documented.

identity_cost.detail: unverified: not stated in the source card. `email` is the assumed value because every priced host in the set requires an account, and no signup was performed, so the kind is not established for this provider

reliability_note: no reliability event recorded in the source passes
confidence_note: the announcement page was read on 2026-10-22 and states the per-second metering, the paused-sandbox behaviour and the size ladder. The USD 25 credit the record carried is not on it, so the verdict moves to paid-only on what the page does say

evidence.proved: listed in the peli-cloud corpus card at commit f6a71ab0; the card is the source, not the vendor page

'Cloud Sandboxes are pay-as-you-go. We meter compute by the second, and nothing else. A paused sandbox costs nothing. Volumes, egress, and hosting public images and Kits are free.' with sizes from Micro at $0.07 an hour (1 vCPU, 2 GiB) to XL at $1.12 (16 vCPU, 32 GiB), quoted
